suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment exposure associated malignancy. Require documented heart transplantation, chronic post-transplant immunosuppression, and separately diagnosed skin malignancy after transplant. Do not infer skin cancer from transplant status alone. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation of the qualifying treatment/procedure exposure for Heart Transplant Residuals
Independent diagnosis of Melanoma / Non-Melanoma Skin Cancers and timing relative to that exposure
Dose, duration, procedure details, and relevant co-exposures where applicable
Qualified clinical assessment of competing causes and exact source-phenotype fit
